Container.Name: MusicBot
Container.Overview:
A cross-platform Discord music bot with a clean interface. Fork of JMusicBot, now maintained and updated. Supports YouTube, SoundCloud, local files, and more. Edit config.txt to add your bot token and owner ID.
Container runs as non-root (UID 10001). Ensure config folder is writable by this user.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Folder for config.txt, playlists, and bot files. Default config.txt is auto-generated on first run.
